title: My Future Job
description: Practise going to, will and jobs vocabulary, then write about the job you want to do.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: 🚀 When I grow up, I ___ to be an astronaut.
exercises.explanation: Use "am going to + verb" for a plan.

exercises.prompt: Write the job.
exercises.text: 🐾 A person who helps sick animals is a ___.
exercises.explanation: A vet looks after sick animals.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: She is going to be a teacher.
exercises.explanation: Subject + be + going to + be + job: She is going to be a teacher.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: A doctor is a person ___ helps people when they are ill.
exercises.explanation: Use "who" for people.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My sister is going be a pilot.
answers: My sister is going to be a pilot.
exercises.explanation: We need "to" after "going": going to be.

exercises.prompt: Write who, which or where.
exercises.text: A hospital is a place ___ doctors and nurses work.
exercises.explanation: Use "where" for places.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I think robots ___ do many jobs in the future.
exercises.explanation: Use "will" for predictions about the future.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: You should study hard if you want to be a doctor.
exercises.explanation: You should study hard if you want to be a doctor.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word WILL. Begin: "My ..."
exercises.text: I am sure that my brother is going to be famous.
exercises.explanation: "Will" can also show something we are sure about in the future.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: Minh ___ run very fast when he was six.
exercises.explanation: "Could" is the past of "can": he could run fast.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: If you practise every day, you ___ (get) better.
exercises.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I have wanted to be a chef since I am seven.
answers: I have wanted to be a chef since I was seven.
exercises.explanation: After "since" we use the past simple: since I was seven.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: A pilot ___ wear a uniform at work.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it we use "has to".

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: If it rains we will stay at home.
If it rains, we will stay at home.
exercises.explanation: If + present simple, will + verb: If it rains we will stay at home.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My dad works ___ a bank in the city.
exercises.explanation: We say "work at a bank".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the adjective in brackets.
exercises.text: ✈️ Being a pilot is ___ (exciting) than working in an office.
exercises.explanation: Long adjectives use "more": more exciting.

exercises.prompt: Complete the second sentence so that it means the same as the first. Use the word MOST. Begin: "A ..."
exercises.text: No job is as interesting as a space scientist.
answers: A space scientist has the most interesting job.
A space scientist is the most interesting job.
exercises.explanation: "No job is as interesting" means "the most interesting".

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: At six o'clock my mum were cooking dinner.
answers: At six o'clock my mum was cooking dinner.
exercises.explanation: Use "was" with I, he, she and it.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: I am not sure. I ___ be a singer or a dancer.
exercises.explanation: "Might" shows something is possible but not sure.

exercises.prompt: Write because, so or but.
exercises.text: I like animals, ___ I want to work in a zoo.
exercises.explanation: "So" shows the result: I like animals, so I want to work in a zoo.

task.prompt: Write about the job you want to do in the future.
contentPoints: Say what job you are going to do.
Say why you want this job.
Say what you will do every day.
Say what you must learn now.
usefulLanguage: When I grow up, I am going to be ...
task.modelAnswer: When I grow up, I am going to be a vet. I want this job because I love animals and I like helping them. Every day I will look after sick dogs and cats. I should study science now and I must be kind and patient. If I work hard, I will be a good vet. I think it will be a great job.
